annotations.title: Propose a real order for the person to approve

description: Connected AI apps with the 'live' permission: PROPOSE a real-money order on the person's Terminal account. Nothing is sent: the person gets a notification on their devices and approves it in the Terminal (approve_url, expires in 15 minutes), then it goes through the same path as their trade ticket, with the same fees and checks. Always give the person approve_url and wait; then call get_live_proposal. Actions: open (market — fills up to 5% from the price at approval — or limit with stop_loss, within 5% of the market if it crosses; stop_loss + take_profit go together as one bracket; leverage required), close (a fraction or all of a position), protect (stop and/or take profit on an open position), cancel (an open order by order_id from get_live_account). Your agent's limits apply (max_order_notional_usd, asset_allowlist).

action.description: open a position, close (part of) one, protect one with stop/take profit, or cancel an open order

coin.description: Market name exactly as in list_markets or get_live_account (e.g. BTC, ETH, xyz:TSLA)

fraction.description: close only: share of the position to close, 0–1 (default 1 = all)

leverage.description: open: REQUIRED, leverage 1–100 within the market's maximum (the person sees it before approving)

limit_price.description: open with order_type limit: the entry price

note.description: Why you propose it, in one or two sentences; the person sees it on the approval screen

order_id.description: cancel only: the order_id from get_live_account.open_orders

order_type.description: open only: market (default) or limit (needs limit_price and stop_loss)

size_usd.description: open only: position size in USD (minimum $10); units are computed at approval with the price then

stop_loss.description: open (bracket, required for limit) or protect: stop-loss trigger price

take_profit.description: open (together with stop_loss) or protect: take-profit trigger price

name: propose_live_order
